source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.6.0, data build 946, released 2026-09-02

parts.target: A **LEGIONES DAEMONICA SLAANESH MONSTER** unit of yours on the battlefield.
parts.effect:
Every unit on the battlefield inside the [Shadow of Chaos](vsdata:ability/chaos-daemons.the-shadow-of-chaos) of your army takes a [Battle-shock test](vsdata:core-rule/battle-shock), with -1 to the test if it is **Below Half-strength**.

**Designer's Note**: units of both armies inside your Shadow of Chaos take the test. That can let you heal your own units through your **Daemonic Terror** army rule, though some of them can end up **battle-shocked**.
